capabilities: add HTML classes to whole Markdown blocks via a `class:` line before them
add HTML classes to specific elements such as list items or table cells
apply multiple classes separated by commas
use the shorter `cls:` or `.class` prefix syntax
render targeted elements identically in Live Preview and Read mode
extras: Classes only apply inside Obsidian; in other Markdown editors the `class:` blocks render as plain inline code. Notes become Obsidian-exclusive to that extent.
motivation: The author rewrote the Obsidian Stylist plugin to focus exclusively on custom HTML classes, support Live Preview, and fix bugs where classes were not properly re-appended after a targeted block was edited.
problem: Wrapping Markdown in a `<div class="...">` breaks rendering in Live Preview and Read modes and makes notes less readable, so there is no clean way to add custom classes for CSS targeting.

relations.evidence: originally inspired by the Obsidian Stylist plugin but has been entirely rewritten

summary: Plugin that renders an inline `class:` code block before or inside Markdown elements to attach custom HTML classes for styling.
